name: route_document_input_tool
description: Select the BADGERS document intake workflow from the source file extension. DOCX routes to native DOCX page planning; PDFs and supported image files route to the existing page-image converter. Legacy DOC, DOCM, PowerPoint, and Excel files are not accepted by this feature.

document_path.description: S3 URI or absolute file path. Its extension determines the intake contract.

session_id.description: Runtime session ID to pass to the selected processor.

result.description: JSON routing decision containing input_type, extension, processor_tool, processor_specialist, and result_contract.
